title: Minuta 2025-12-18
summary: The minutes of the 18 December meeting record the 4-1 cut to 7.00% with Heath dissenting for a hold, but the member-by-member discussion makes the pause signal in the communique more explicit and so reads a notch more hawkish than the communique itself. Of the four members who voted to cut, all ask for more gradualism or caution: one wants the cycle to proceed 'con mayor gradualidad y cautela' and speaks of its future 'reanudación', another wants the guidance to say the inflation outlook will be assessed before moving again, a third calls outright for a 'wait and see' approach, and only one stresses that the cycle 'no ha concluido', while still favouring slower cuts in H1 2026. Heath goes further than in the communique's vote line, arguing that a real rate in the neutral zone sends the wrong signal and that a later hike may have to be considered if convergence fails. The dovish pillars (weak activity and investment, a cooling labor market, a strong peso, the Fed's cut) remain, and the majority treats the 2026 IEPS and tariff changes as one-off, but core at a year-high and services above 5% justify the slowdown. Versus the November minutes, where the debate was mainly about softening the commitment to cut, the Board now converges on a pause after this cut.

key_quotes.quote: Externó que hacia delante el ciclo de recortes debe proceder con mayor gradualidad y cautela.
key_quotes.context: A member who voted to cut asks for a slower pace and links the 'resumption' of cuts to the absence of second-round effects

key_quotes.quote: Sostuvo que, tomando en cuenta todo lo anterior, deberá adoptarse un enfoque de esperar y ver.
key_quotes.context: Another member backs the cut but calls for wait-and-see from here

key_quotes.quote: Externó que es relevante señalar que el ciclo de recortes no ha concluido
key_quotes.context: The most dovish voice still wants to say the cycle is not over, though with more gradualism in H1 2026

key_quotes.quote: Incluso, si observamos en este tiempo que la convergencia no se va alcanzar, habría que evaluar la posibilidad de más adelante volver a incrementar la tasa objetivo.
key_quotes.context: Heath's dissent: hold at an equilibrium level and keep a future hike on the table
